sources.title: nvidia/Nemotron-3-Diarization-preview · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Description Nemotron 3 Diarization is an open-weight streaming speaker diarization model designed to determine "who spoke when" in real-world audio. It supports both streaming and offline inference, handles up to eight speakers, and orders speaker outputs by each speaker's first arrival in the input audio.

sources.snippet: NVIDIA's Nemotron 3 Diarization is a 100M open model that tracks up to eight overlapping speakers at 14.72% DER. Latency modes, license and how to use it.

sources.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Family of Models
sources.snippet: We announce NVIDIA Nemotron 3, the most efficient family of open models with leading accuracy for agentic AI applications. The Nemotron 3 family consists of three models: Nano, Super, and Ultra.
